scope: Independent read-only review of the complete current native Save helper, complete memory export policy and all seven focused tests, plus exact caller/authority/readback seams. No source edit, test execution, process launch, artifact download, ledger or ref change.

knownObservedBlocker.scope: Isolated native Save helper candidate, not full installed verification.
knownObservedBlocker.result: Both helper lanes failed startup before the helper ready event; Electron fixtures themselves were ready. No trigger, dialog input or saved completion ran.

finalCandidateChecklist.invariant: Use the actual spawned installed child PID and exact installed executable after CDP nonce/executable verification. Node liveness remains active. PowerShell validates image and stable process-start ticks before discovery and each action; PID reuse or exit refuses. No app-name/title-only owner lookup.

Only exact-PID top-level EnumWindows results are converted with UIA FromHandle. Enumeration remains capped at 32 owned windows. Match exact Export project memory title and Window type. Refuse pre-existing or multiple matching dialogs, bind one nonzero native handle, and recheck Win32 and UIA process identity. Provider initialization may repair accessibility discovery; it must not remove these constraints.

Within that admitted dialog require exactly one Edit with AutomationId1001 and Name File name:, plus exactly one Button with AutomationId1 and Name Save. Require exact owned PID, enabled state, writable ValuePattern and InvokePattern. No ID-only, coordinate, SendKeys, arbitrary Win32-input or force-click fallback.

Check dialog/owner/target before setting the fixed destination; read Value back exactly; rediscover the unique same dialog and fresh controls before invoking Save; recheck destination absence and exact Value. Unknown layout remains a fixed failure with bounded metadata.

Only installed-memory-redacted-export.json inside the canonical identity-verified evidence root is accepted. It is absent before dispatch. The native lease pins ordinary local ancestors, exact root volume/index and the existing single-link owner.json without deletion sharing. It stays held through completed receipt and file readback, then explicit release acknowledgement. No renderer-controlled destination or production setSavePath override.

Read only an ordinary non-symlink regular file, 1 through1048576 bytes, through a handle whose device/inode/size match before and after. Revalidate physical profile/evidence root. Actual bytes/hash must match renderer native completion; parsed strict export must bind the current scope, redact sensitive text and omit source bodies.

Authenticated same-origin/CSRF export and strict scope checks precede the native bridge. IPC uses the authorized exact main frame/current document and eligible bound surface. The main policy parses strict redacted schema, rejects secret-bearing/NUL item text, generates canonical JSON, digest and Windows-safe fixed filename, and accepts no path parameter.

Default-deny session guard stays active for arbitrary, remote, plug-in and unrelated downloads. One pending export per WebContents and at most4 overall; 8MiB input/canonical bounds. Admission requires exact contents/mainFrame/current document/initiator origin/random URL/single URL chain/filename. Consume before callbacks; a second event is denied. Main navigation/destruction cancels the grant/item.

Native setSaveDialogOptions retains the exact title and filename-only default; no setSavePath. CDP download behavior must be default, with reset acknowledgement. Saved status requires DownloadItem completed and exact received byte count; cancellation stays separate. Renderer verifies filename/bytes/SHA. The installed proof waits for saved acknowledgement plus actual file readback, not only will-download admission.

Preserve10s download admission,5min native policy completion; helper30s discovery bounded by60s script polling and75s outer wall deadline,100ms liveness/polling,32768 stdout bytes,16384 stderr-count bound, at most7 parsed events and24 bounded control identities. Any final fixed-script argv remains below32767 UTF-16 characters including executable, flags, quotes and NUL; the existing guard fails closed.

Require ready,dialog-found,file-name-set,save-invoked,dialog-closed,target-released in order for the same PID/start ticks/handle and monotonic elapsed time. No success before completion callback and physical readback. Release while the lease is still held; require explicit target-released, worker close0/null signal and live installed owner. Worker failure terminates only its owned process tree, preserves refusal and cannot become success through late async settlement.

Fixed metadata-only stages/reasons, bounded fixed control identity spellings and counts only. Do not retain input values, source text, arbitrary native window text, provider exceptions or stderr bodies. JSON/schema validation errors remain sanitized. Worker stdin contains only validated owner/path identity, never command code.

commandMeasurement.method: Read-only extraction of the fixed String.raw script and the same indentation removal/base64 encoding used by installedNativeSaveCommand; no PowerShell execution.

coverage: Complete argv length, declared Windows path validation and absence of ExecutionPolicy override
Absent fixed destination and ordinary readback
Redirected directory/output rejection with preserved original bytes
Replaced root and empty/oversized readback rejection
PID reuse, changed handles, backward time, missing stages and forged-field rejection
Bounded fixed failure metadata without unrelated control text or false completion
existingTestScope.limits: These source-level/fixture tests do not execute Windows provider initialization, UIA discovery, native controls or a real Save dialog.

futureAdmission: A successful direct-dialog or production-policy diagnostic is narrower than the complete installed default-off retained-memory flow. Final full CI and the real artifact must separately supply source-bound native completion, saved bytes, Forget/restart and owned cleanup; no new optional proof gate is introduced.
